maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from new pistols, revolvers and rifles sold first-time through distributors, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Firearms sold mostly to consumers via dealers and distributors; law enforcement and military sales are a minor part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own firearms brands; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up strategy.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer firearms are discretionary; dealers and buyers can switch to Glock, Ruger, Sig and other brands easily.
